title: Independent higher-degree/order JGM2 short-arc validation
scientific_cautions: This 30-minute short-arc matrix follows the independently passed 1D.0 shared-state acceleration gate.
All GMAT and Python models use the same frozen normalized JGM2 coefficients and full validated R2026a EOP realization.
GMAT STK-TimePosVel states are accepted only on the preregistered 10-second grid tolerance; state vectors are never interpolated by Research Core.
Tides, drag, third bodies, solar radiation pressure, and relativity are disabled.
Thresholds must not be loosened after inspecting GMAT outputs merely to obtain a pass.
A pass authorizes a separate multi-case full-arc gate; it is not measured-orbit truth or flight qualification.
